title: Existence of a normalized quotient section tensor comparison
statement: For every morphism a of commutative condensed rings and scheme T, fixed ScalarSectionData c satisfying ScalarSectionNormalized and TensorIso b satisfying TensorNormalized admit a section derived tensor isomorphism barB satisfying SectionTensorNormalized.

proof.text: Obtain the underlying comparison, then its pure-tensor formula, and finally the signed-total K-flat normalization; package these three results as SectionTensorNormalized.

proof_origin.place: Reduction of parent proof steps 1--5 into three strictly simpler obligations.

theorem section_tensor_transport_normalized (T : Scheme.{u})
    (c : ScalarSectionData a T) (hc : ScalarSectionNormalized a T c)
    (b : TensorIso a T) (hb : TensorNormalized a T b) :
    ∃ barB : tensor Λ T ⋙ c.model.T ≅
        (c.model.T.prod c.model.T) ⋙ tensor Λ' T,
      SectionTensorNormalized a T c barB
